name: IKAROS Ai Commerce Infrastructure
author: Ikaros Ai

sections.description:
Ikaros helps AI assistants and AI shopping agents understand your products so they can recommend them to users.

It generates AI-friendly product data and discovery endpoints for WooCommerce stores.

Features

  • AI Commerce Manifest for machine-readable product data.
  • AI Product Optimization to generate short AI-friendly product descriptions.
  • AI Bot Analytics to track AI and crawler visits.
  • AI Protocol Support including AI commerce manifests, MCP tools, and discovery endpoints.
  • AI Visibility Score based on bot activity, product coverage, content quality, and crawl frequency.
  • AI Policy Control to allow or block AI bots and crawlers.

Pro features

  • Bulk AI Optimization for catalog-wide updates.
  • Vision AI Product Descriptions generated from product images.
  • Advanced analytics and AI performance insights.

Privacy

This plugin can log visits from known AI crawlers. Logging is disabled by default and can be enabled in Settings > Features.

Stored fields in bot logs:
* Bot name (detected from user agent)
* User agent string (truncated)
* Visited endpoint/path
* Request method
* Timestamp
* Product ID (when applicable)

Cookie usage:
* ikaros_bot_ref (30 days) may be set when AI-assisted buy links are used, to support AI-attributed checkout flows.

No analytics JavaScript or third-party tracking pixels are injected on the frontend by this plugin.

Site owners are responsible for configuring consent/privacy notices as required by local law.

External services

This plugin utilizes the Google Gemini API to generate product summaries and descriptions.

  • Service: Google Gemini API
  • Usage: Used only when you click “Generate” in the product editor.
  • Data sent: Product title, product description context, selected model identifier, and API request metadata needed to generate text output.
  • Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ikaros-ai-manifest directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Ikaros AI settings page to configure features.
  4. Optional: Add your Google Gemini API key to generate AI product descriptions.
sections.changelog:
2.2.1

  • Fixed: ACP cart-dependent endpoints now initialize WooCommerce session, customer, and cart during REST requests.
  • Fixed: ACP add-to-cart, status, and checkout endpoints no longer fail with cart unavailable on stores where REST cart bootstrap was missing.
  • Improved: ACP production reliability for end-to-end agent checkout flow.

2.2.0

  • Added: ACP endpoints for products search, add-to-cart, checkout, and status under the REST API.
  • Added: ACP discovery metadata to the REST manifest (acp_supported and ACP endpoint URLs).
  • Changed: Product purchase_url now uses native WooCommerce add-to-cart flow.
  • Changed: Added ai_summary, product_category, and categories fields to manifest catalog items.
  • Changed: Deprecated custom direct-buy handler hook in favor of WooCommerce-native purchase flow.

2.0.0

  • Added: Dashboard page for AI visibility, bot category analysis, and top endpoint/product insights.
  • Added: Analytics page enhancements (date range filtering, bot intent classification, activity table, charts, CSV export).
  • Added: AI Readiness Score in product list (sortable/filterable column and bulk recalculate action).
  • Changed: Renamed “Intelligence” section to “Dashboard”.
  • Changed: Consolidated free settings and policy controls into one unified Settings page.
  • Security: Strengthened nonce validation and request hardening for admin and AJAX flows.

1.1.1

  • Security: Removed API key exposure from JavaScript; keys now only transmitted via AJAX POST.
  • Security: Added null check for product object in schema injection function.
  • Security: Fixed database query preparation for bot log retrieval.
  • Compliance: Removed feature gating on bot statistics charts (now always visible to all users).
  • UX: Added menu icons in admin pages.

1.1.0

  • Feature: Added support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI agents.
  • Feature: Added Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) discovery endpoint.
  • Fix: Improved security by replacing strip_tags with wp_strip_all_tags.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
